**First public release of ClaudeMDSwitcher.**

Switch your `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` profile from a macOS menu bar icon. Auto-discovers `CLAUDE.*.md` profile files, swaps via atomic symlink rename, backs up the original on first use.

**Install:** download `ClaudeMDSwitcher-v1.0.0-arm64.zip`, unzip, drag to `/Applications`, right-click → **Open** the first time (ad-hoc signing — see README).

**Requires:** macOS 14 Sonoma or newer, Apple Silicon.

See [README](https://github.com/kaanxweb/claude-md-switcher#readme) for setup and [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/kaanxweb/claude-md-switcher/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for details.
